# The Deliberation Journey — journey.pm

The Deliberation Journey is a software-development methodology for the agentic
era: trunk-based development with one lift — the trunk holds the whole product,
not just code, and each branch is a deliberation journey carrying decisions,
evidence, and deltas over that whole product, which returns to the trunk as
permanent understanding. Consensus binds to intent and observable behavior;
code is a disposable projection. This site is the methodology's public
documentation: plain prose, no tracking, no external requests.

## Pages

- [The Five-Minute Version](https://journey.pm/summary/): the whole methodology on one page — the problem, the one lift, the four artifact regimes, two gates, and the return.
- [The Model](https://journey.pm/methodology/): product definition, journey, return — the core model, its four artifact regimes, its one-lift statement, and the axiom.
- [Deliberation](https://journey.pm/deliberation/): how a journey earns agreement — the two gates, per-role consensus, evidence, type and risk, states, and the return.
- [Invariants](https://journey.pm/invariants/): the three invariants any conforming implementation must provide — the conformance test for the methodology.
- [Comparisons](https://journey.pm/comparisons/): a condensed map of the landscape as partial implementations: trunk-based development, OpenSpec, Spec Kit, Kiro.
- [Glossary](https://journey.pm/glossary/): every term defined once — four artifact types, journey, intent, delta, return, the gates, type, blast radius and risk, implementation terms, and the retired vocabulary.
- [Blog](https://journey.pm/blog/): working notes — the naming story, the announcement, and (planned) comparison deep-dives and the metrics model.
- [About](https://journey.pm/about/): what this site is, who runs it, and the license.

## Feed
